title: Budget and Revenue
text:
Do films with larger budgets generate higher box-office revenues? Figure 1 shows the relationship between production budgets and worldwide revenues.

plt.scatter(films["budget_musd"], films["revenue_musd"])
plt.xlabel("Production Budget (Million USD)")
plt.ylabel("Worldwide Revenue (Million USD)")
plt.title("Budget vs. Revenue")
plt.show()







Figure 1: Production Budget VS Worldwide Box-Office Revenue

title: Box Office Numbers
text: This dataset includes 104 well-known films from 1980 to 2025, with approximate budgets, worldwide revenues, runtimes, and ratings. All money-related numbers are in millions in usd, and runtime is in minutes.

title: Runtime and Ratings
text:
Is there a relationship between film runtime and rating? Figure 1 shows the rating of each film against its runtime in minutes.

plt.scatter(films["runtime_min"], films["imdb_rating"])
plt.xlabel("Runtime (Minutes)")
plt.ylabel("IMDb Rating")
plt.title("Runtime vs. Rating")
plt.show()







Figure 1: Film Runtime VS IMDb Rating
